Ryan Pemberton

  • Audio
  • Teaching
  • Coding
  • Contact

Audio

I'm a producer and audio engineer for podcasts.

I've sound designed and mixed podcasts for The Guardian, ABC, and iHeart Australia.

I made Umwelt, a podcast about how different animals experience the world.

Currently, I'm the senior audio engineer for the iHeart Australia podcast network.

Teaching

I teach a podcasting course at the University of Sydney, lecture for other educational institutions and community organizations, and work with individuals and businesses to develop and improve their podcast production workflow.

Coding

I often write code to automate aspects of my podcast production work (usually in Python or Lua).

I also like to play around with code, just for fun. Like with this website that plays bird sounds that were recorded under the current position of the International Space Station.

In 2021, my colleague Alex Tighe and I created a podcast that gives up-to-the-minute weather forecasts, geotargeted to the listener's location (within Australia).
